data.name: The Hero's Adventure Log
data.detailed_description:
In the Kingdom of Verde, the tale of the hero has been passed down for many millennia. It's said that the summoned hero will one day walk the land and aid the citizenry in their time of need.

Seemingly as prophesied, in the wake of Verde's missing queen and a series of mysterious thefts, you have awoken on the side of the road with no memory. Battered and confused, you are told that it's your job as the otherworldly hero to help the people of Verde and unravel the mysteries surrounding your summoning!

The only guidance you receive is:

Express yourself honestly.

Give them warmth.

Ensure our happiness.

In this adventure game, explore Verde's capital, Ridomi, and get to know the citizens you swore to protect! Whether through direct control or on-screen navigation, move between the maps where characters abide by a routine schedule.

On your journey, be sure to manage your time as you may not be able to access certain areas without some help. Pay close attention to what the citizens have to say, and pursue every lead you find! Speak to the NPCs scattered around the maps and unveil the mystery of the missing queen before the neighboring country invades at the end of the year! If you stay in your room and neglect your duties as a hero for too long, everyone's affinity for the hero will drop! So manage your time wisely...

Be sure to talk to key characters and spend time with them. Pursue their individual quests to learn more about this colorful cast. Once you raise their affinity, it may lead to uncovering the secret of the missing queen... or perhaps even your own.

And don't worry, everyone in Ridomi will do their best to take care of their hero!

Figure Out Your Routine

Explore Ridomi and spend time with the locals! You might even uncover the secrets of your summoning along the way!

Get to Know Everyone

Ridomi has thirteen characters the hero can get close to and exchange pleasantries with! "Greet" them to unlock a unique animated sex scene just for that character!

Engage in Visitations

Invite any of thirteen girls to your room to get to know them and engage in nightly activities! You can change their clothes and even spend a full weekend with them!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 8/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 11/10/8
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
